node.title: backticks and system()
node.author: ytjPerl
node.doctext:
Hi Monks,
I have a window command "Runbatch.exe dpsgl -j dpsgl -r dpstst". directory is set.
when I put this command in confi.txt and in perl, I use backticks to execute it, it works. but when I use system(), system('Runbatch.exe dpsgl -j dpsgl -r dpstst'), it does not work. it throws out error indicating this runbatch.exe not found.
Can you advice why? I suppose system() and backticks function the same.
Thanks.
